Officials Highlight Women's Safety Measures and Community Cooperation

Meghalaya Deputy Chief Minister Prestone Tynsong has called for community cooperation to ensure women's safety. In Delhi, Chief Minister Rekha Gupta emphasized that women's safety and child protection are key priorities, highlighting the availability of helplines, shelter homes, and CCTV surveillance.
